wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal contract accepts only a client error with no content; a panic or 500 fails the security tests' client-error assertion and the functional suite
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: every handler authorises the exact file or metadata entry it is about to return; there is no neighbouring or proxy object that could be checked instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the publish visitor is the reader role only; RoleVisitor is rejected by the authentication middleware before any route decision, and the workspace owner is the positive control, so there is no second non-owner role that can reach these routes (instruction narrowed to the reader accordingly).
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: all protected endpoints return files or metadata; no write or mutating route reaches this sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is a cleaned filesystem path, not a parsed identity; cleanStaticRelativePath rejects the malformed spellings before any decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: publication state is local configuration; an absent or unreadable state denies rather than admits, so there is no authority that can fail open
